patterns: APPSC asks single-fact items: Bt gene gives insect resistance, Bt brinjal developed for insect resistance, largest Bt cotton state = Maharashtra, GM flagged for biodiversity impact.
Across PSCs the Bt source (Bacillus thuringiensis, a bacterium), Golden Rice (pro-vitamin A, daffodil gene) and Bollgard I/II recur.
Terminator technology (seeds incapable of forming viable seeds) and Cas9 as molecular scissors are standard UPSC-style one-liners.
Many PYQs filed here are really hormones/cell biology; genuine topic PYQs stay at definitional depth.
App MCQs add SDN categories, gene drives, base editing and 2026 news items; several match lists are artificially built from note fragments.
